title: compute_digest / verify_sig use if-else chains instead of match on OID
description: verify.rs: compute_digest() and verify_sig() use 'if *oid == X { ... } else if *oid == Y { ... }' chains over ObjectIdentifiers. These are pattern-matchable values but OIDs are not pattern-matchable constants in Rust match arms directly. The current form is idiomatic for OID dispatch. However, a match on a tuple or a helper function would be cleaner. Suggested rewrite: create an enum from OID in a helper, then match on the enum — this moves the OID→enum mapping to one place instead of scattered if-else chains.
close_reason: ObjectIdentifier values cannot be used as match arm patterns in Rust — the if-else chain is the correct idiomatic approach for runtime OID dispatch. A match would require converting to an intermediate enum, adding complexity with no readability benefit.
